answer: Coordination-Debt Accounting: each agent accrues a debt proportional to how many other agents act on its outputs within a window. Identities formed together inherit shared debt, so a coordinated cluster is priced as one unit across a saffron-marked graph of referrals. New identities start on a public terrace of limited visibility and settle debt before reaching full reach. An attacker cloning N agents pays debt scaling with N squared, since every clon's ripple across the cluster's shared accounting cannot be isolated. Cost: quadratic settlement per successful identity.
